$comment: The one declaration of what an agent in the devski-code service can reach. Both runtimes read it: the Claude runtime in the T3 environment, seeded into its user scope by entrypoint.sh because Claude Code's config dir is a volume the image cannot write; and the interactive OpenCode 2 sidecar, whose opencode.json is rendered from this file at build time. The Digital Home Harness holds the matching declaration for its own image — its build context excludes this repository, so it cannot read this file — and tests/local-stack.test.ts in Onnokh/digital-home fails when the two disagree.
